entry.summary: Visa-free short stays as part of the Schengen area.
entry.max_stay: 90 days in any 180-day period across the Schengen area
entry.pre_arrival: None today. ETIAS is on the watch list.
entry.other: Schengen Entry/Exit System: fingerprints and photo at the border on first entry (free, nothing to do beforehand). Get an entry stamp where one is still given, and carry your passport across internal borders.

money-and-cost.cash_card_notes: Estonia's currency is the euro. You must declare currency of 10,000 euro or more, or the equivalent if you're travelling between Estonia and any non-European Union country. This covers all forms of currency, not only cash. If you don't declare your currency, authorities will fine you. You don't need to declare cash if you're travelling to or from another EU country.

consular.notes: There's an Australian Consulate in Tallinn. The office provides limited consular assistance. It doesn't offer visa and immigration services or notarial services, or issue passports.

laws.rule: Penalties for drug offences include heavy fines and jail, even for possessing small amounts.
laws.heading: Drugs

laws.rule: Same-sex relationships are legal and same-sex marriages are recognised by Estonian law. Attitudes towards same-sex relationships can be conservative.
laws.heading: Other laws

laws.rule: You must have a valid Australian driver's licence to drive in Estonia (digital driver’s licences are not accepted). You may also need an International Driving Permit (IDP) to hire a vehicle. Ask the car rental company when you book. Get your IDP before you leave Australia.
laws.heading: Driving permit

tourism.detail: Visa-free short stays as part of the Schengen area.

meetings.detail: Business meetings are covered, without being employed in the country.

conference.detail: Business travel, including conferences, is covered.

unpaid-speaking.detail: Unpaid speaking during a business visit is generally covered; the paid-activity exclusion is read narrowly.
unpaid-speaking.next: If unsure, ask Embassy of the Republic of Estonia, Yarralumla.

paid-speaking.detail: Paid activity isn't covered by the visa-free stay; most member states need a national visa and work permit, even under 90 days. Ask the Embassy of the Republic of Estonia, Yarralumla.
paid-speaking.next: Paid activity isn't covered by the visa-free stay; most member states need a national visa and work permit, even under 90 days. Ask the Embassy of the Republic of Estonia, Yarralumla.

remote-work.detail: Remote work for an employer outside the EU isn't addressed in the EU guidance read.
remote-work.next: Ask the Embassy of the Republic of Estonia, Yarralumla.

entrepreneur.detail: Exploring and meeting fit a business visit; running a business needs national permission.
entrepreneur.next: Ask the Embassy of the Republic of Estonia, Yarralumla.

trade.detail: Business visits are covered; selling or delivering services may be paid activity.
trade.next: Keep the trip to meetings and negotiation.

artist.detail: Paid activity isn't covered by the visa-free stay; most member states need a national visa and work permit, even under 90 days. Ask the Embassy of the Republic of Estonia, Yarralumla.
artist.next: Paid activity isn't covered by the visa-free stay; most member states need a national visa and work permit, even under 90 days. Ask the Embassy of the Republic of Estonia, Yarralumla.

mixed-mission.detail: The visa-free stay covers the business and tourism parts; any paid part needs national permission.
mixed-mission.next: Ask the Embassy of the Republic of Estonia, Yarralumla.

filming.route: Visa-free Schengen short stay (journalistic or media purposes)
filming.detail: Journalistic or media purposes are listed among visa-free purposes; paid production work and location permits are national matters.
filming.next: Ask the Embassy of the Republic of Estonia, Yarralumla about filming, and the local authority about locations.

research.route: Visa-free Schengen short stay (short-term study or training)
research.detail: Short-term study and training are covered; paid research at an institution is paid activity.
research.next: Ask the Embassy of the Republic of Estonia, Yarralumla if the host pays you.

volunteering.detail: Volunteering isn't addressed in the EU guidance read.
volunteering.next: Ask the Embassy of the Republic of Estonia, Yarralumla.
